name: Pane
text: Pane: A thin anchored sidebar still risks users overlooking it if they’re focused on the graph’s center, and the permanent footprint isn’t trivial—it’s a visual tax on every session. Better: a micro-interaction—hover or a single click on the graph’s edge—to summon the legend instantly, then auto-hide after use. Settle it with A/B testing: measure how often users reopen the legend in each design, and whether they complete tasks faster with the hover trigger.
